title: Eni uses AVEVA PI Vision to improve real-time oil field monitoring
summary: Eni feeds PI data into simulation models that act as a digital twin of an oil field in its Southern District.
challenge: There was no real-time data for modelling, and data collection was slow.
solution: PI data, shown in PI Vision, drives the oil-field digital twin.

outcomes.text: No Eni-specific outcome figures are stated
outcomes.reportedBy: AVEVA (customer success story)

verifyNote: The AVEVA page also shows a DCP Midstream "$25M" figure that belongs to DCP, not Eni. Do not attribute it to Eni.

title: Global E&P AF data object model
summary: Eni's global exploration and production business deployed PI AF collectives on all major production assets, with a global E&P AF data object model and template repository.
challenge: E&P assets were diverse, there was no standardisation, and decisions were reactive.
solution: A global E&P AF data object model "with extensive templates", with PI-to-PI used for data quality and security.

outcomes.text: Improvements in preventable lost production, lifting cost and reliability are described as estimated, with no figures
outcomes.reportedBy: OSIsoft (EMEA UC 2015 deck)

title: New Downstream Program on PI
summary: MOL ran PI-based energy and reliability applications across 6 refineries under its New Downstream Program (NDSP).
challenge: Low cultural alignment and few decisions based on data.
solution: The New Downstream Program, with PI System across the fuels value chain and PI-based energy and reliability applications.

outcomes.text: Yield increase 5%

title: PI System as refinery integration infrastructure
summary: YASREF (Yanbu Aramco Sinopec refinery), a new grassroots refinery, used PI System as the integration and application infrastructure for 23 separate applications.
challenge: 23 separate applications from multiple vendors had to be delivered on an aggressive schedule.
solution: Standalone applications were migrated onto PI AF, and all calculations and analytics run once in the infrastructure.

outcomes.text: Smooth startup and a "reduction of over 50% in standard applications"
outcomes.reportedBy: OSIsoft (EMEA UC 2015 deck citing a YASREF speaker)

title: From data to dollars: the rapid integration of AVEVA PI System into BPX Energy upstream operations
summary: BPX Energy rolled PI System out across the enterprise in 12 months, with a focus on PI AF and use cases such as electrical submersible pump (ESP) optimisation and compressor run time.
challenge: Not stated in the presentation abstract.
solution: A PI AF-centred rollout with ESP optimisation and compressor run-time use cases.

outcomes.text: A "shift in mindset" and value across the organisation (no figures given)
outcomes.reportedBy: The company (John Burroughs, BPX) in an AVEVA World 2023 presentation abstract

verifyNote: Source is a presentation abstract only; details were not confirmed from the full deck.

title: Journey to operational excellence: AVEVA PI System transformative influence at Pertamina
summary: Pertamina's refinery business describes PI AF as the "core pillar" of its refinery data effort, combined with PI Vision smartphone apps, AVEVA Production Accounting and AVEVA Predictive Analytics.
challenge: The challenge was "translating the vast volume of data into useful insight".
solution: PI AF plus mobile PI Vision apps, with AVEVA Production Accounting for loss quantification.

outcomes.text: No outcome figures are stated in the abstract
outcomes.reportedBy: The company (PT Kilang Pertamina Internasional speakers) in an AVEVA World 2023 abstract

verifyNote: Source is a presentation abstract only; details were not confirmed from the full deck.

title: Integrated downstream dashboard
summary: Pertamina integrated its fuels value chain, from crude source to distribution, on a common PI infrastructure with a central operations centre.
challenge: Conflicting data, depot stock-outs and high demurrage (charges for delayed vessel loading and unloading).
solution: All downstream solutions migrated onto a common PI infrastructure.

outcomes.text: Critical depot stock-outs reduced by 60%
outcomes.reportedBy: OSIsoft (Graves) at a 2014 São Paulo regional seminar

outcomes.text: Demurrage reduced by 40%
outcomes.reportedBy: OSIsoft (Graves) at a 2014 São Paulo regional seminar

outcomes.text: Overall savings of "10s of Millions"
outcomes.reportedBy: OSIsoft (Graves) at a 2014 São Paulo regional seminar

title: Predictive and proactive gas T&D
summary: PG&E's gas transmission and distribution business used PI AF for advanced alarm management, notification and condition-based monitoring of critical assets after the 9/9/2010 gas explosion.
challenge: A mandate to implement NTSB and PHMSA 49 CFR 192 requirements, and systems that were not integrated.
solution: PI AF for alarm management, notification, condition-based monitoring and mobility.

outcomes.text: Qualitative: safer, more reliable gas transmission and distribution (no figures given)
outcomes.reportedBy: OSIsoft (seminar deck quoting a PG&E engineer)

title: Noble Energy's path to operations excellence
region: Gulf of Mexico, Eastern Mediterranean, West Africa, US onshore
summary: Noble Energy replaced its Cygnet system with PI in phases, building a PI AF structure across departments and using PI ahead of the Aseng FPSO startup.
challenge: Noble needed to replace legacy monitoring and prove ROI for an enterprise agreement.
solution: A PI AF structure across departments, with PI in place before the Aseng FPSO startup.

outcomes.text: PI during the Aseng startup helped engineers increase production by an estimated 10,000 barrels of oil per day
outcomes.reportedBy: The company (Joe Hill, Shawn Cole) in an OSIsoft seminar presentation

verifyNote: The source gives the year as 2014-2015 (2014 regional seminar URL, source id says 2015), so no single year is set.

title: Gaining critical visibility into systems and assets with AVEVA PI System
summary: DCP Midstream uses PI System and PI Vision so field crews can monitor sites remotely across 57,000 miles of gathering pipeline.
challenge: Existing systems were not designed for analytics, and field rounds were long.
solution: A single PI view of operations.

outcomes.text: "$25M saved in fiscal year 2017 from improved plant operations"
outcomes.reportedBy: AVEVA (customer success story)

title: Reducing equipment downtime and saving millions with early failure detection
summary: PETRONAS implemented a cloud-enabled early-warning system for rotating equipment in 2019, using AVEVA Predictive Analytics on PI System data.
challenge: Rotating equipment failures went undetected and experts were spread across many locations.
solution: AVEVA Predictive Analytics running on PI data.

outcomes.text: $33 million saved from reduced unplanned downtime, based on 51 warnings including 12 high-risk ones (stated as 20x ROI)
outcomes.reportedBy: AVEVA (customer success story)

outcomes.text: Asset utilisation up 0.1% per plant
outcomes.reportedBy: AVEVA (customer success story)

title: Intelligent midstream solutions digitally transform pipeline operations
summary: TC Energy integrated AWS machine-learning models with PI AF and AVEVA pipeline software for linepack forecasting and gas-control dashboards.
challenge: Scenario planning for the gas pipeline network was slow.
solution: AWS machine-learning models integrated with PI AF.

outcomes.text: "$8 million in demonstrated value from strategic dashboards"
outcomes.reportedBy: AVEVA (customer success story)

title: World-scale LNG facility boosts field efficiency and safety
summary: Cameron LNG feeds mobile operator rounds and LoRaWAN wireless sensors into a PI Server of about 70,000 tags and more than 5,000 AF elements.
challenge: Operators lost 30 to 60 minutes per day travelling to collect data.
solution: Field data collected into PI, with DCS graphics in PI Vision.

outcomes.text: Avoided "millions in potential instrumentation costs" (no exact figure)
outcomes.reportedBy: AVEVA (customer success story)

title: Using AVEVA pipeline solutions to operate one of the world's largest SCADA systems
summary: Enbridge is consolidating 37 proprietary SCADA systems onto AVEVA Enterprise SCADA, with PI Server used for calculations, analytics and reporting, including ESG metrics. The work was 50% complete in 2024.
solution: Commercial off-the-shelf SCADA plus PI Server for analytics and reporting.

outcomes.text: 37 proprietary SCADA systems replaced with one
outcomes.reportedBy: AVEVA (customer success story)

outcomes.text: More than 350,000 tags integrated
outcomes.reportedBy: AVEVA (customer success story)
